params.entry_discipline_rule: Before entering on a fresh MACDh flip (this bar or 1 bar prior), check: has price already moved more than roughly 1% in the flip direction over the last 1-2 ticks, AND is RSI already extended (>65 for a bullish flip, <35 for a bearish one)? If both are true, treat this as the peaked-pump chase pattern strategy.md already warns against (never chase a peaked pump). In that case, either require one additional independent confirming signal beyond the flip itself, or size down meaningfully, or skip and wait for a pullback/second confirmation.

four_day_synthesis.recommendation: Do not promote as hard params.json rule — evidence base too thin. Promote as strategy.md judgment heuristic: 'On fresh MACDh flip, if RSI >65 and price run >1%, treat as peaked-pump — require extra confirmation or skip.'
